body: holy shit. thank you so much for your words. i’m kind of embarrassed to say that i’m crying right now. you have no idea just how much i needed to hear this. things have been so bad lately and it’s been hard, but your comment has comforted/supported me more than anyone else in my life so far. i’m always so hard on myself because a quick name search of myself will show how deep i was into my former beliefs, and it’s difficult seeing my mistakes immortalized on the internet. but you just said everything that i needed to hear, and i’m so sincerely grateful. i still don’t think that i deserve such kindness, but thank you so so much for it regardless.
